page: Amazon Web Services r7gd.medium is an entry-tier memory-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor and powered by an arm64 AWS Graviton processor with ARMv8 Neoverse-V1 cores. The instance provides 1 dedicated physical core (1 vCPU) operating at 2.6 GHz, backed by 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. Memory capacity stands at 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio. For local high-speed I/O, the instance bundles a 59 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume. Baseline networking throughput is provisioned at 1 Gbps, and no discrete GPUs are included.

Synthetic compute benchmarks reflect consistent single-threaded performance balanced against strict core constraints. In single-core testing, the instance achieved an average-tier score of 1440.0 in Geekbench and 1516.59 in stress-ng evaluations. Because the server features only one physical core, multi-core metrics match single-core outputs, registering 1436.0 in Geekbench multi-core and placing overall parallel compute in lower benchmark tiers compared to multi-core instances. Memory bandwidth demonstrates 97.21 GB/sec on cached 16 KB read blocks, dropping to 30.72 GB/sec on uncached 256 MB reads and 10.9 GB/sec on large write streams. Single-threaded bzip3 decompression reached 9.34 GB/sec, while Redis SET operations yielded 1.72 million operations per second.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, r7gd.medium offers a resource-efficient footprint for memory-demanding workloads requiring direct fast local scratch storage without provisioning surplus compute cores. The primary architectural tradeoff is total parallel throughput: with a single core and 1 Gbps baseline network, processing pipelines are bound by thread serialization. The instance is suited for lightweight caching layers, small-footprint in-memory databases, Redis nodes, temporary data staging, and low-concurrency development environments requiring an 8 GB memory buffer with NVMe scratch space.
description: Amazon Web Services r7gd.medium is an entry-level memory-optimized instance running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor with the arm64 ARMv8 Neoverse-V1 architecture. Configured with a single dedicated vCPU operating at 2.6 GHz, 8.0 GB of system memory, and a bundled 59 GB local NVMe SSD, it delivers an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio suited for high memory density at small scale. The processor features 64 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache, providing competitive single-thread benchmark output including 1440.0 on Geekbench single-core and 1516.59 in stress-ng. However, its single-core configuration inherently caps multi-core throughput and concurrency, accompanied by a 1 Gbps baseline network speed. The included high-speed NVMe storage provides fast temporary disk access for IO-sensitive operations. Overall, r7gd.medium is well-suited for small in-memory key-value stores, Redis caches, staging environments, and single-threaded batch processing workloads requiring dedicated RAM.
